iti108:2.1: Ye keci bhikkhave bhikkhū kuhā thaddhā lapā siṅgī unnalā asamāhitā, na me te bhikkhave bhikkhū māmakā,
iti108:2.2: apagatā ca te bhikkhave bhikkhū imasmā dhammavinayā, na ca te bhikkhave bhikkhū imasmiṃ dhammavinaye vuddhiṃ virūḷhiṃ vepullaṃ āpajjanti.
iti108:2.3: Ye ca kho bhikkhave bhikkhū nikkuhā nillapā dhīrā athaddhā susamāhitā, te ca kho me bhikkhave bhikkhū māmakā,
iti108:2.4: anapagatā ca te bhikkhave bhikkhū imasmā dhammavinayā, te ca bhikkhave bhikkhū imasmiṃ dhammavinaye vuddhiṃ virūḷhiṃ vepullaṃ āpajjantīti.
